entries.title: Psalms 60:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; set to aShushan Eduth. Michtam of David, to teach; and when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand.>> O God thou hast cast us off, thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; oh restore us again.

entries.title: Psalms 60:2
segments: Thou hast made the land to tremble; thou hast rent it: Heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

entries.title: Psalms 60:3
segments: Thou hast showed thy people hard things: Thou hast made us to drink the wine of staggering.

entries.title: Psalms 60:4
segments: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, That it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 60:5
segments: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.

entries.title: Psalms 60:6
segments: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

entries.title: Psalms 60:7
segments: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

entries.title: Psalms 60:8
segments: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe: Philistia, shout thou because of me.

entries.title: Psalms 60:9
segments: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who hath led me unto Edom?

entries.title: Psalms 60:10
segments: Hast not thou, O God, cast us off? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

entries.title: Psalms 60:11
segments: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.

entries.title: Psalms 60:12
segments: Through God we shall do valiantly; For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
